choices: An if inside another if's block
questions.explain: Nesting means the inner condition is only reached when the outer one was true.

questions.prompt: How is the inner if marked as inner?
questions.explain: Indentation is the only thing that says which block a line belongs to.

questions.prompt: When is combining conditions with `and` better than nesting?
choices: When both must be true and there is no separate action for the outer one alone
questions.explain: Deep nesting gets hard to read. If there is nothing to do between the two checks, one combined condition is clearer.
